title: feat: wp11 attest <slot> CLI subcommand (PIV attestation)
description: Attestation is a provisioning step, not a runtime operation, and no standard PKCS#11 mechanism exists for it. The right delivery vehicle is a CLI subcommand: wp11 attest <slot> fetches the device-signed attestation certificate from the YubiKey (GENERAL AUTHENTICATE in attestation mode, slot 0xF9), prints it as PEM to stdout, and exits. The output is a certificate the user submits to a CA alongside a CSR to prove the key was generated on-device. No C_* changes. No vendor-defined PKCS#11 extension. Depends on multi-slot support (wolfP11-2t8) being in place so slot IDs are stable.
